title: Finance Operation Manager - Accounts Payable Quality Assurance
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 You are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: In addition to a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, mental health, and vision coverage for you, your spouse/partner, and children.


**Your Impact**
 You will take ownership of the end\-to\-end accounts payable Quality Assurance operations at our Chennai office, leading strategic initiatives that drive efficiency, regulatory compliance, and alignment with our global organizational goals.
   

  

 You will work within our collaborative Finance Operations team to help individual team members and the broader function achieve their full potential through holistic interventions in performance, capabilities, and organizational health.
   

  

 You will provide strategic leadership by developing accounts payable strategies and partnering with senior leadership to identify and address systemic finance challenges and opportunities. You will foster a team culture centered on continuous improvement, exceptional service delivery, and operational excellence.
   

  

 You will oversee the performance and professional development of your finance team, including team leads, process leads, and finance managers, by conducting regular evaluations and providing constructive feedback. You will identify key training and capability needs, facilitate relevant development programs, and actively support the recruitment, onboarding, and mentorship of emerging finance leaders.
   

  

 You will drive process standardization across accounts payable functions, identifying bottlenecks and implementing innovative solutions to optimize workflows. You will co\-lead strategic technology initiatives to automate invoice processing and leverage modern tools to enhance overall operational efficiency.
   

  

 You will lead and manage critical finance projects from inception to completion, coordinating with various stakeholders to ensure objectives are met and resources are utilized effectively. You will monitor project progress, proactively address challenges, and provide regular updates on milestones to senior leadership.
   

  

 You will oversee the daily operations of the quality assurance teams to ensure smooth service delivery, reviewing and approving critical financial reports to guarantee accuracy and strict compliance with standards. You will monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), manage operational risk, implement robust internal controls, and take decisive corrective actions to achieve targets.
   

  

 You will build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with global offices, procurement teams, and other business units, acting as a trusted liaison between finance teams and key internal or external stakeholders. You will represent the finance function in audits, formal engagements, and cross\-functional corporate initiatives.
   

  

 You will be based in our Chennai Office as part of our Finance Global Operations service line.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Degree in finance, accounting, or a related field
* 12\+ years of extensive experience in Global Accounts Payable Operations—including invoice processing, compliance, and financial reporting—within fast\-paced, multinational environments
* 5\+ years of leadership in a multinational shared services environment, with a proven track record of managing large, diverse finance teams and leading multiple functions
* Strong technical expertise in finance processes, accounting principles, and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), with hands\-on experience in SOX compliance, internal audits, and AP QA trend analysis
* Prior experience with process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) along with exposure to AI implementation and stabilization
* Proficient in rational, data\-driven decision\-making, logical reasoning, and creating high\-quality, product\-focused work materials and outputs
* Excellent organizational capabilities, including the ability to work in\-person, initiate tasks independently, and see them through to completion within complex, autonomous environments
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English and local office language(s), with the ability to tailor communication styles to diverse audiences and seniority levels

title: Sr. Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 Serve as a senior test analyst specializing in MES validation and automation for hybrid work model projects ensuring high quality manufacturing execution solutions through rigorous functional integration and AI assisted testing. Apply expertise in Camstar MES platforms and multi layer integration to improve reliability reduce defects and support efficient supply chain operations while collaborating with diverse global teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for MES validation that align with project scope regulatory expectations and enterprise quality standards ensuring reliable delivery of manufacturing execution capabilities across hybrid work environments.
* Develop and maintain detailed automated test suites for MES applications using suitable frameworks focusing on regression coverage repeatability and rapid feedback to project teams to reduce release cycle times and production defects.
* Perform thorough manual functional and integration testing for MES features where automation is not yet feasible documenting clear test conditions reproducible steps and evidence to support release readiness decisions.
* Validate and test MES L4 L3 and L2 integration flows across enterprise planning systems shop floor control systems and field devices ensuring accurate data exchange timing and transaction integrity for manufacturing and supply chain scenarios.
* Configure and validate Camstar MES features workflows and business rules in test environments ensuring that process configurations meet user requirements while upholding data integrity and traceability standards for regulated manufacturing contexts.
* Utilize generative AI tools in a compliant manner to accelerate test design test data generation and defect analysis while applying critical judgment to review AI generated outputs for accuracy relevance and risk.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility.
* Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements.
* Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components.
* Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team.
* Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles.
* Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in MES validation and automated testing with a proven track record of owning test design execution and reporting for complex enterprise scale implementations.
* Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments.
* Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively.
* Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness.
* Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions.
* Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting.
* Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

title: Test Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




 Effy (Rayles and Roobie Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a Chennai\-based custom software development company and Freshworks Premium System Integration Partner, building integrations, middleware/APIs, and marketplace apps for clients across fintech, retail, media, and legal sectors. This role owns quality assurance across all client integrations and Freshworks marketplace apps and also acts as the technical point of contact for support requests raised by clients, customers, and partners making this a hybrid QA and technical support/customer success role.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Quality Assurance \- Integrations \& Marketplace Apps
* Design, execute, and maintain test plans and test cases for all client integrations (API\-led, point\-to\-point, cloud\-based, and event\-driven) across platforms such as Freshdesk, Freshservice, Freshsales, Freshchat, Freshcaller, Freshmarketer, and third\-party systems (e.g., Shopify, Magento, ServiceNow, and Azure AD).
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing for all Freshworks marketplace apps prior to release and after every update.
* Validate data migrations and middleware/API connections for data accuracy, reliability, and basic security considerations.
* Log, track, and triage defects through resolution, working closely with developers and project managers.
* Contribute to building and maintaining automated test scripts and suites where applicable to improve coverage and release speed.
* Support release management by signing off on builds before deployment to production or the Freshworks Marketplace.
* Maintain test documentation, checklists, and QA metrics/reports for ongoing and completed projects.
* Technical Customer Success \& Support
* Serve as the first technical point of contact for support requests from clients, customers, and partners across all live integrations and marketplace apps.
* Triage, reproduce, and resolve reported issues; escalate complex or product\-level bugs to the relevant development team with clear reproduction steps.
* Track support tickets end\-to\-end, ensuring timely responses and resolutions in line with agreed SLAs.
* Communicate clearly with clients, customers, and partners, translating technical issues and fixes into plain\-language updates.
* Maintain and update internal knowledge bases, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides based on recurring issues.
* Identify patterns in support requests and feed them back into the QA process to prevent recurrence.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in software testing/QA, ideally including SaaS integrations or API testing.
* Solid understanding of manual and automated testing methodologies (functional, regression, integration, UAT).
* Working knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman and REST/SOAP testing tools.
* Working knowledge of issue\-tracking tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile/sprint\-based delivery.
* Basic understanding of databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB for data validation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non\-technical clients.
* Customer\-facing experience or demonstrated comfort handling support tickets and client communication.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with close attention to detail.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Prior hands\-on experience with Freshworks products (Freshdesk, Freshservice, Freshsales, Freshchat, Freshcaller, or Freshmarketer) as a user, tester, or support agent.
* Experience testing marketplace/plugin apps for any SaaS ecosystem (Freshworks, Salesforce, Zendesk, Shopify, etc.).
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Postman collections/Newman) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with middleware, webhooks, or event\-driven integration testing.
* Basic proficiency in JavaScript, Node.js, or Python.
* Prior experience in a customer success, technical support, or solutions engineering role.
* ISTQB or equivalent QA certification.



  





 What We Offer
 


* The opportunity to own quality end\-to\-end across a live, growing portfolio of client integrations and Freshworks marketplace apps.
* Direct exposure to enterprise clients across fintech, retail, media, and legal sectors.
* A collaborative, culture\-first engineering environment centered on client success and continuous learning.
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience.

title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Our Mission:**
 We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.
   

  

**About Us**
 Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.


**Test Strategy \& Coverage**
* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.


**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**
* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.


**XML and Publishing Validation**
* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.


**Data Layer Testing**
* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.


**API and Integration Testing**
* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.


**Performance and Reliability Testing**
* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.


**Collaboration \& Execution**
* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.


**Experience And Skills**
**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor’s in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG \& EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud\-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

title: Sr System Validation Engineer

description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non\-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In\-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Resiliency Test Engineering role is responsible for the validation of non\-functional requirements for resiliency testing.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Deepen understanding of the DTCC Software Delivery Process and proactively identify opportunities for improvement within assigned responsibilities.
* Execute performance test scenarios based on user stories, requirements, and application architecture.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance performance test scripts using Apache JMeter and other automation frameworks.
* Design and implement test automation solutions to support performance, scalability, and resiliency validation.
* Create and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate performance test execution, reporting, and continuous validation.
* Develop and maintain Groovy\-based Jenkins pipeline scripts for test orchestration and automation workflows.
* Execute and manage performance tests using BlazeMeter, including test scheduling, execution, analysis, and reporting.
* Analyze test results, identify performance bottlenecks, and provide actionable recommendations to development and engineering teams.
* Track execution of performance test scenarios and communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Build knowledge of Delivery Pipeline components and recommend enhancements to improve automation, efficiency, and reliability.
* Develop a strong understanding of the products, applications, and business processes being delivered.
* Follow DTCC performance engineering standards, policies, and procedures in day\-to\-day activities.
* Demonstrate strong technical ability to develop scripts, write code, and automate testing processes.
* Align risk and control processes with daily responsibilities to monitor, mitigate, and appropriately escalate risk.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in Performance Engineering, Test Automation, Software Development, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands\-on experience developing and executing performance tests using Apache JMeter.
* Experience using BlazeMeter for performance test management, execution, reporting, and analysis.
* Experience building and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience developing automation solutions using Groovy scripting.
* Strong programming experience in Java and object\-oriented design principles.
* Experience with Python for automation, test engineering, scripting, and data processing.
* Familiarity with source control tools such as Git/Bitbucket.
* Understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and Continuous Testing practices.


 Talents Needed for Success
   

  

* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within and across teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to review deliverables and ensure quality, accuracy, and adherence to standards.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with Java development, including APIs, multithreading, Spring Boot, and enterprise application frameworks.
* Experience developing and maintaining Groovy scripts for Jenkins pipeline automation.
* Experience integrating JMeter and BlazeMeter within CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with Python development for automation and tooling.
* Experience with React development, including building and maintaining modern web\-based applications and dashboards.
* Ability to troubleshoot application and performance issues using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools.
* Understanding of performance engineering concepts including: \- Load Testing
* Stress Testing
* Endurance/Soak Testing
* Scalability Testing
* Capacity Planning
* Performance Tuning
* Bottleneck Analysis


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience working with enterprise\-scale distributed systems and cloud\-based applications.
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting high\-volume transactional applications in financial services environments.
* Familiarity with resiliency testing, failure mode analysis, and non\-functional requirements (NFR) validation


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

description:

**Senior Engineer, Technical Operations**
**Your role in helping us shape the future:**
 As a
 **Sr. Engineer, Technical Operations,** 
 you will be an initial point of contact for software deployments, production issues (Software) related to SES Infight’s core services such as In\-Flight Connectivity (IFC)/In\-Flight Entertainment (IFE)/IPTV on retrofit and next generation Onboard Experience (OX) architectures and Satellite network performance. You will have desire to gain thorough technical knowledge on end\-to\-end system for providing quick analysis and driving resolution on production issues. In addition, you will be creating various dashboards and status reports for executives and end customers. You will be expected to build strong system/network level technical knowledge and use critical thinking to resolve issues faster.
   

  

 Additional responsibilities include but not limited to engage in PI (Agile teams) to understand the roadmap of upcoming features and services, lead the strategic oversight of platform and network performance, ensuring optimal performance, high reliability, and exceptional end\-user experience, lab setup for reproducing field issues and writing automation scripts for generating reports.
   

  

**Are you up to the challenge?**
* Desire to learn and champion new technologies and overall end\-to\-end system
* Develop a strong background in SES Infight’s technology platforms (ESA, KU, 2KU, ATG, ATG4 and autonomous IFE/IPTV) as well as third party technologies
* Understanding complex systems and able to diagnose and isolate the failures to a product/component level
* Deploying software to aircraft and monitor deployment performance

* Triage software defect via strong analysis techniques (log/data analysis, defect tracking, etc.). Determine and document initial root cause, impact, severity, and frequency of failures

* Generate test plans for reproducing field issues in lab environment
* Create reports for complex/critical production issues for senior management
* Define, develop and improve production diagnostics tools and defect analysis tools for quick turn around
* Support returned box analysis from production
* Support the field operation team by troubleshooting/triaging SW issues by following the defect management process (SPI/IRB), while being a strong voice for process adherence.
* Lead the resolution of network performance issues through strategic coordination across internal teams and provide expert technical support for airline performance and customer escalations to SES’s customer\-facing teams.
* Independently educate and manage internal and external stakeholders on performance metrics such as Latency, Speed, Packet Loss, Jitter, and the utilization of managed service fabric. Provide strategic guidance to ensure stakeholders have a clear understanding and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Lead comprehensive reviews and analyses of existing data collection systems. Provide strategic recommendations on improvements, maintenance, or other factors to significantly enhance system performance, reliability, and efficiency.
* Occasional travel to support new install/maintenance activities
* Ability to work at IST overnight \-\- till 3pm US Chicago time
* Rotation of shift every quarter to half year


**You should have:**
* System thinking skills for isolating issues within a complex network
* BS degree in Engineering/Computer Science disciplines
* 10\+ years of system level troubleshooting experience working on complex systems
* 5 years of relevant experience in the satellite and/or telecommunications industry
* TCP/IP, Linux/Shell Scripting, Packet Capture/WireShark, Jira, Wiki, Test Director
* JQL, SQL, Python, Java, Go, Git, Jenkins (CI), Spinnaker (CD), AWS OpenSearch
* Tableau, Power BI, Network Analysis
* Excellent Verbal/written communication skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong understanding of capacity and time management
* Flexibility to work occasional weekends or off hours, as emergencies arise
* Proactively seek continuous learning and continuous improvements
* Mentor new members and create personal development goals


**It would be nice if you had:**
* Strong networking background with CCNA/CCNE certifications
* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe PI), DevOps and SRE
* Exceptional techno\-commercial business acumen in satellite communication network rollout, influencing strategic decisions and project success.
* Advanced technical competency in VSAT Network Platform operation methodologies and mastery of TDMA systems such as Gilat with comprehensive knowledge of their functionality, performance, and system operations.


**What it’s like to work with us:**
 Intelsat is connecting the world and transforming the satellite and inflight connectivity landscape by reaching beyond the traditional satellite industry. We are defining new products that will open new, profitable markets. We connect the aviation industry and air travelers with innovative technology and applications, and we do it all in a high\-energy environment that welcomes the next challenge. To help us reach this goal, you should be a bold thinker who will perform a key role in shaping Intelsat innovation for years to come.

Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

 This role is accountable for assisting with for detailed design for certain modules/sub\-systems, doing prototype for multi\-vendor infrastructure, and showcasing it internally or externally to clients.

* Assists with writing, updating and maintaining the technical program, end\-user documentation, and operational procedures.

* Basic understanding of cloud architecture and services in multiple public clouds like AWS, GCP, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft Office 365\.
* Developing subject matter expert in programming languages such as C/C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, libraries and frameworks.

title: Associate - Reporting Production Expert
description:
**Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Associate
   

  

**Department:** 
 Asset Management – Investment Operations
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Reporting Production Analyst
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The Reporting Production Analyst is responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of regulatory transaction reporting obligations across EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II covering both EU and UK jurisdictions, and ASIC Rewrite. The role sits at the heart of the first line of defense for regulatory reporting, ensuring that all reportable transactions are submitted accurately, completely and on time to the relevant Trade Repositories and Approved Reporting Mechanisms across jurisdictions.
   

  

 Reporting to the Regulatory Transaction Reporting team, the Production Analyst works as part of a team with interchangeable resources, each expected to operate across all four regulatory regimes and across both EU and UK jurisdictions where applicable. This versatility is essential to ensure business continuity, balance workload across the team, and provide a single, consistent operating standard regardless of the reporting regime. For SFTR and MiFID II, the Analyst is responsible for the hands\-on day\-to\-day production of regulatory reporting. For EMIR and ASIC, which are delegated, the Analyst is responsible for the oversight and monitoring of the production performed by the service provider, ensuring reporting obligations are met.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on production (SFTR, MiFID II), oversight of outsourced reporting performed (EMIR OTC, ASIC), oversight of delegated EMIR reporting on ETD performed by clearing brokers, exception remediation, accuracy controls, reconciliations, pairing \& matching, and reporting to senior stakeholders. It requires strong attention to detail, an in\-depth understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics across EU and UK regimes, and the ability to challenge and monitor an outsourced provider as effectively as performing the reporting directly.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* OVERSIGHT \& MONITORING OF OUTSOURCED REPORTING EMIR EU, EMIR UK, ASIC


 Perform daily oversight of the EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC reporting production carried out by 3rd party Service Provider (SP), ensuring completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all reporting to DTCC.
   

  

 Monitor 3rd party SP daily production, submission status and exception handling, and challenge the provider where standards are not met.
   

  

 Review and validate the controls performed 3rd party SP, ensuring they are operating effectively and evidenced.
   

  

 Reconcile the internal trade population against the reports submitted by 3rd party SP to identify missing, duplicated or incorrectly reported transactions.
   

  

 Track and escalate persistent issues, recurring exceptions or SLA breaches by 3rd party SP to RTR team.
   

  

 Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting second\-line oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
   

  

 Act as the point of contact for 3rd party SP on EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC production matters.
   

  

* DAILY TRADE AND TRANSACTION REPORTING ACROSS SFTR (EU AND UK), MIFID II (EU AND UK)


 Execute daily production reporting, ensuring all reportable trades and transactions are submitted within the regulatory deadlines.
   

  

 Monitor reporting platforms and intraday flows to ensure timely capture and submission of all reportable events.
   

  

 Validate report content against source systems post submission.
   

  

 Track submission status and ensure all reports reach a final accepted state by Trade Repository or ARM/APA.
   

  

* REJECTIONS AND EXCEPTIONS REMEDIATION


 Investigate and remediate all rejections (NACKs) and exceptions raised by the reporting platforms and/or Trade Repository across EU and UK regimes.
   

  

 Identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing) and apply the appropriate corrective actions.
   

  

 Make the necessary amendments and resubmit corrected reports within the regulatory timeframe applicable in each jurisdiction.
   

  

 Maintain a clear audit trail of remediation activities for compliance and oversight review.
   

  

* DAILY AND MONTHLY RECONCILIATION


 Perform daily reconciliation on SFTR, MIFID, across EU and UK scopes to identify missing, incorrect or duplicated reports, investigate breaks, and implement remediation actions to resolve reconciliation breaks.
   

  

 For EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC, reconcile the internal data against 3rd party SP reported output as part of the oversight function.
   

  

 Execute monthly reconciliations to validate the consistency between source data, and data submitted.
   

  

 Document reconciliation results and escalate unresolved breaks to the Regulatory Transactions Reporting team with proposed resolution actions and timeline.
   

  

* OVERSIGHT OF DELEGATED EMIR REPORTING ON ETD SCOPE PERFORMED BY CLEARING BROKERS


 Validate completeness, accuracy and timeliness of reports submitted by clearing brokers.
   

  

 Engage directly with clearing brokers to investigate discrepancies, request amendments and ensure corrections are made within the regulatory timeframe.
   

  

 Track and escalate persistent issues or recurring reporting failures to RTR team.
   

  

 Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting RTR oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
   

  

* PAIRING AND MATCHING


 Investigate and resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions across EU and UK regimes, engaging directly with counterparties where required.
   

  

 Manage UTIs processing in line with internal procedures.
   

  

 Monitor and secure pairing and matching rates as a key indicator of reporting quality.
   

  

* REPORTING TO RTR TEAM


 Prepare and share daily statistics and dashboards for all jurisdictions (EU and UK for EMIR/MIFID/SFTR and ASIC) covering reported volumes, pairing and matching rates, accepted volumes, rejection rates and remediated volumes.
   

  

 Highlight emerging/faced issues, trends or risks to the RTR team in a timely and structured manner.
   

  

* CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND KNOWLEDGE SHARING


 Identify ad escalate recurring issues.
   

  

 Maintain up\-to\-date procedures, runbooks and knowledge base for all four regulatory regimes.
   

  

 Cross\-train and support fellow team members to maintain full interchangeability across the team.

In this role, you will execute and plan testing activities for VisionPLUS\-related projects, with a focus on ensuring quality, traceability, and delivery readiness across card processing platforms. You will work closely with internal technology teams, user acceptance testing teams, and project stakeholders to deliver structured test execution and issue management for regulated financial services environments.

* Execute test planning and test execution activities for small projects and assigned release initiatives across compliance, BAU, and migration programs.

* Document test execution results and provide end\-of\-day project test reporting for assigned initiatives.
* Manage defects independently using established defect management processes and tools, and act as a coordination point between UAT teams and internal technical teams.
* Support presentment file preparation and testing for card scheme processing and transaction validation.
* Use test management, defect management, automation, and AI\-enabled testing tools to support efficient execution and documentation of the testing lifecycle.
* Act as an incident management lead during dress rehearsal and go\-live events for assigned projects.
* Participate in continuous improvement activities to strengthen test processes, deliverables, and quality outcomes.

**Experience You’ll Need To Have**

* 4\+ years of experience in preparing test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test scripts from business requirements and functional specification documents.
* 4\+ years of experience in using test management and defect management tools such as ALM/QC, JIRA, or qTest.

* 4\+ years of experience in automated test case creation, maintenance, and execution using test automation frameworks.

title: Systems Analyst
description:
**Job Overview**
 Hubbell is seeking a highly motivated Systems Analyst – Logistics to join our global IT organization. This role will support the design, implementation, and ongoing optimization of warehouse and logistics systems across global operations, with strong collaboration across U.S. and India teams.
   

  

 The role focuses on SAP WM and EWM, with exposure to SAP PP, MM, QM and integrated logistics platforms such as Blue Yonder WMS, MercuryGate TMS, and SmartBOL. Candidates should bring strong functional knowledge, analytical thinking, and the ability to work in a global delivery model.
   

  

 A Day In The Life
   

  

* Work with business stakeholders to gather and document requirements and translate them into system solutions.
* Support end\-to\-end delivery including requirement analysis, design, system configuration, testing, and production support.
* Act as functional SME for SAP logistics processes (IM, WM, EWM).
* Collaborate with cross\-functional global teams to ensure successful solution delivery and adoption.
* Develop and execute test cases, support UAT cycles, and validate system changes.
* Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer to business teams.
* Support change management and comply with IT governance and audit controls.
* Maintain system roles, authorizations, and basic security configurations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and support small to mid\-sized project delivery.


 What will help you thrive in this role?
   

  

* Strong experience in SAP Logistics Execution modules (IM, WM, EWM).
* Understanding of integration concepts including IDOCs, CPI/BTP, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with SAP Fiori environment is preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in a global delivery model (onsite\-offshore coordination).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience with test management and validation processes.
* Basic understanding of project management practices (Agile/Waterfall).


**Hubbell Incorporated**
 Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.
   

  

 The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.
   

  

 We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.
   

  

**Hubbell Unified Business Solutions**
 Hubbell Unified Business Services (HUBS) provides corporate shared services to support all businesses across the enterprise. Functional areas include Engineering, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Legal, IT, Human Resources, Payroll, Environmental Health \& Safety, and Compliance. HUBS employees are located around the world.

title: ERP Functional QA Tester
description:
**Job Title:** 
 ERP Functional QA Tester
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai (Hybrid)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 1–2 years
 



  





**About the Role** 




  We are looking for an ERP Functional QA Tester to validate the customizations and configurations on ERP platform for client implementations. You'll work closely with implementation consultants and developers to test business workflows against client requirements and ensuring every customization actually works the way the client's business runs, before it goes live.
 



 We need someone who understands core business processes — accounting, buying, selling, manufacturing in particular and can think like an end user (accountant, production supervisor, storekeeper) to catch functional gaps.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ·      Review client requirement documents/BRDs and translate them into test scenarios and test cases
 



 ·      Test end\-to\-end business flows for customizations built on the ERP (forms, workflows, reports, print formats, permissions, email automations)
 



 ·      Validate manufacturing flows: BOM (Bill of Materials), Work Order, Job Card, material consumption, production stock movement
 



 ·      Validate accounting flows: sales/purchase invoicing, payments, journal entries, ledger impact, GST/tax calculations, stock\-to\-accounts reconciliation
 



 ·      Validate Buying flows: Sales order to Sales Invoice conversion
 



 ·      Perform functional, integration, and regression testing before client UAT and go\-live
 



 ·      Log defects clearly (steps to reproduce, expected vs actual result) and track them to closure with the dev team
 



 ·      Support clients during UAT by clarifying flows and re\-validating fixes
 



 ·      Maintain test case documentation and sign\-off checklists for each client deliverable
 



  
 **What We're Looking For** 




 ·      1–2 years of experience in an accounting, manufacturing/production, or ERP functional/support role
 



 ·      Solid understanding of core accounting concepts (invoices, ledgers, payments, GST taxes)
 



 ·      Understanding of manufacturing process flow: BOM → Work Order → Job Card → finished goods
 



 ·      Prior exposure to any ERP system (SAP, Oracle, Odoo, Frappe/ERPNext, Tally, Zoho, MS Dynamics, etc.) is a strong plus
 



 ·      Detail\-oriented, methodical, and comfortable following/writing structured test cases
 



 ·      Good communication skills since you'll be interfacing with client requirements and internal dev teams
 



 ·      Basic comfort with Excel/Sheets and any bug\-tracking tool is a plus
